Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection, likely with lower urinary tract involvement. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
